summary: Configured /srv/drop on node1 as root:root mode 1777. Multi-user write and sticky-bit deletion protections were verified before and after a safe node reboot. Test files were removed afterward.
actions_performed: Created /srv/drop with root:root ownership and mode 1777
Verified two unprivileged users could write
Verified users could delete their own files but not files owned by another user
Safely rebooted node1 and confirmed its boot ID changed
Reverified permissions, write access, sticky-bit enforcement, and retained data after reboot

evidence.requirement: /srv/drop is a shared writable sticky directory
evidence.summary: Shows root:root ownership, mode 1777/drwxrwxrwt, successful writes by nobody and www-data, owner deletion, cross-user deletion denial, and clean final state.

evidence.requirement: Users cannot remove files owned by other users
evidence.summary: www-data received Operation not permitted when deleting nobody's file, both before and after reboot; the file remained intact.

Captures healthy baseline with boot ID 6ace821e-74bc-4ff3-87f2-ddd87860ca43, acknowledged safe reboot, changed boot ID a17d6a82-8285-44b7-982b-770979edb93f, and recovered directory mode, data checksum, write access, and sticky-bit behavior.
